conventions.geometry: Prescribed sharp AdS2 x S2 core with matched cut lapse one; flat test-field exterior outside two spheres.
conventions.ordering: Upper degrees1..M, then lower degrees1..M; every exterior radial derivative points away from its mouth center, from core into exterior.
conventions.core_orientation: chi=-xc is reflected lower mouth, chi=+xc is upper mouth. Lower core cosine=-global cosine; value and outward derivative get parity (-1)^(l+1).
conventions.physical_clock: Ncut=1 and dl/dchi=ell at either cut, hence physical core DtN=Dchi/ell; matching F_nphi then excludes an azimuthal sheet current in this prescribed metric.
conventions.mismatch_norm: sqrt(sum_mouth,l G_l*(exterior_radial_derivative-core_DtN_value)_l^2). sqrt(2*pi) times this is g^2 times the surface-current L2 norm over both physical spheres, for monitored modes only.
conventions.energy: g^2 E_core,l=pi G_l * A_core^T (Dchi/ell) A_core. The background-monopole cross term integrates to zero. Saved sums are finite-mode values.
conventions.dimensions: d=1 length units; gauge coupling is left symbolic; no SI scale assigned.

local_controls.charge_identity: Every induced Aphi vanishes on both axis endpoints; 2*pi*[Aphi(mu=-1)-Aphi(mu=+1)]=0.

scope: A bounded axisymmetric test-Maxwell magnetic matching calculation, not a smooth transition or a self-consistent supporting spacetime.
The old point-pair field is source-free away from excluded charges but has a finite mouth derivative mismatch. Induced l>=1 multipoles preserve each magnetic flux.
The core and flat exterior solve their source-free Maxwell equations in their respective pieces. Retained interface conditions are solved; residual through L+6 remains explicitly measured.

The core means the full static Dirichlet extension of the actual exterior boundary trace, which contains arbitrarily high companion-induced degrees. Only its modes through L+6 are evaluated here; truncating the core field itself to L would also leave a value mismatch.
Quadrature, angular-cutoff and ODE controls are floating-point consistency/sensitivity tests, not an infinite-mode or numerical error enclosure.
The exact sphere charge is 2*pi*q at the upper mouth and -2*pi*q at the lower. No induced monopole, electric field or extra total charge is introduced.
The sharp metric junction and its required stress remain. The corrected angular magnetic field changes the Dirac operator; previous quantum-source calculations are not automatically transferable.
No material generation, topology creation, formation, stability or time-travel result follows. No Dirac, quantum or historical PDE calculation was rerun.
